Versions of ***The Road Not Taken*** include:

- "[The Road Not Taken](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Mountain_Interval/The_Road_Not_Taken)", from *[Mountain Interval](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Mountain_Interval)* (1916, rev. 1920)
- "[The Road Not Taken](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Collected_Poems_of_Robert_Frost_%281930%29/The_Road_Not_Taken)", from *[Collected Poems of Robert Frost](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Collected_Poems_of_Robert_Frost_%281930%29)* (1930)

This work is in the **[public domain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/public_domain)** in the **United States** because it was published before January 1, 1931.

---

The longest-living author of this work died in 1963, so this work is in the **public domain** in countries and areas where the copyright term is the author's **life plus 62 years or less**. This work may be in the **public domain** in countries and areas with longer native copyright terms that apply the **[rule of the shorter term](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rule_of_the_shorter_term)** to *foreign works*.
